# Optimal Partitioning using R

```{r OP_R}
n <- 100
gap <- 1
data <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(2, 5, 8, 13, 20)*n,
                         parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0),
                         sdNoise = 1,
                         type = "gauss")
beta <- 2 * log(length(data))

# OP Algorithm
OP_R <- optimal_partitioning(data, beta)

# Visualization
plot_segmentation(data, OP_R$changepoints, title = "Optimal Partitioning using R")
cat("Last cost :", OP_R$costQ[length(OP_R$costQ)], "\n")
cat("Changepoints :", OP_R$changepoints)
```

# Optimal Partitioning using Rcpp

```{r OP_CPP}
n <- 100
gap <- 0.5
data <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(2, 5, 8, 13, 20)*n,
                         parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0),
                         sdNoise = 1,
                         type = "gauss")
beta <- 2 * log(length(data))

# OP Algorithm
OP_Rcpp <- rcpp_optimal_partitioning(data, beta)

# Visualization
plot_segmentation(data, OP_Rcpp$changepoints, title = "Optimal Partitioning using Rcpp")
cat("Last cost :", OP_Rcpp$costQ[length(OP_Rcpp$costQ)], "\n")
cat("Changepoints :", OP_Rcpp$changepoints)
```

# Time execution between OP (R) and OP (Rcpp)

```{r Exec_Time_OP}
n_vals <- 10^(seq(1, 1.7, length.out = 100))
gap <- 0.5
temps_R <- numeric(length(n_vals))
temps_Rcpp <- numeric(length(n_vals))
length_data <- integer(length(n_vals))

for (i in 1:length(n_vals))
{
  n <- n_vals[i]
  data <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(2, 5, 8, 13, 20)*n,
                        parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0),
                        sdNoise = 1,
                        type = "gauss")
  length_data[i] <- length(data)
  print(length(data))
  beta <- 2 * log(length(data))
  
  # Temps code R
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  optimal_partitioning(data, beta)
  t1 <- Sys.time()
  temps_R[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs"))
  
  # Temps code C++
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  rcpp_optimal_partitioning(data, beta)
  t1 <- Sys.time()
  temps_Rcpp[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs"))
}

lm_R    <- lm(log(temps_R) ~ log(length_data))
lm_Rcpp <- lm(log(temps_Rcpp) ~ log(length_data))

plot(length_data, temps_R, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "red",
     log = "xy",
     xlab = "log(length_data)",
     ylab = "log(Time in seconds)",
     main = "Execution Time for OP in Log-Log Scale",
     ylim = range(c(temps_R, temps_Rcpp), finite = TRUE),
     xlim = range(length_data, finite = TRUE))
lines(length_data, temps_Rcpp, type = "b", pch = 17, col = "blue")

# Linear prediction for R code
y_pred_R <- exp(coef(lm_R)[1]) * length_data ^ coef(lm_R)[2]
lines(length_data, y_pred_R, col = "black", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

# Linear prediction for Rcpp code
y_pred_Rcpp <- exp(coef(lm_Rcpp)[1]) * length_data ^ coef(lm_Rcpp)[2]
lines(length_data, y_pred_Rcpp, col = "green", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

# Expected slope O(n^2)
middle <- exp((coef(lm_R)[1] + coef(lm_Rcpp)[1]) / 2)
y_theorical <- middle * length_data ^ 2
lines(length_data, y_theorical, col = "purple", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

legend("topleft",
       legend = c(paste("R slope :", round(coef(lm_R)[2], 2)),
                  paste("Rcpp slope :", round(coef(lm_Rcpp)[2], 2)),
                  paste("Expected slope :", 2)),
       col    = c("red", "blue", "purpwle"),
       pch    = c(16, 17),
       lty    = c(1, 1))
grid()
```

# Pruned Exact Linear Time using R

```{r PELT_R}
n <- 100
gap <- 0.5
x <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(2, 5, 8, 13, 20)*n,
                      parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0),
                      sdNoise = 0.2,
                      type = "gauss")
beta <- 2 * log(length(x)) * sdDiff(x, "HALL")^2

# PELT Algorithm
PELT_R <- pelt(x, beta)
PELT_Rcpp <- rcpp_pelt(x, beta)

# Visualization
cpts <- PELT_R$changepoints
plot(x, type = "o", main = paste("PELT using R, beta = ", round(beta, 2)),
     ylab = "Values", xlab = "Time", col = "blue")
abline(v = cpts, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

cpts2 <- c(0,cpts)
for (i in 1:(length(cpts2) - 1))
{
  segment_mean <- mean(x[(cpts2[i] + 1):cpts2[i + 1]])
  segments(x0 = cpts2[i] + 1, y0 = segment_mean,
           x1 = cpts2[i+1], y1 = segment_mean,
           col = "green", lwd = 2)
}
plot(PELT_R$nb, main = "number of studied points for each iteration")
cat("Last cost :", PELT_R$costQ[length(PELT_R$costQ)], "\n")
cat("Changepoints :", PELT_R$changepoints, "\n")
```


# Time execution between PELT (R) and PELT (Rcpp)

```{r Time_Exec_PELT}
start <- 100000 / 20
end <- 1000000 / 20
pas <- 100000 / 20
n_vals <- seq(from = start, to = end, by = pas)
gap <- 0.5
temps_R <- numeric(length(n_vals))
temps_Rcpp <- numeric(length(n_vals))
length_data <- integer(length(n_vals))

for (i in 1:length(n_vals))
{
  n <- n_vals[i]
  x <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(2, 5, 8, 13, 20)*n,
                        parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0),
                        sdNoise = 3.5,
                        type = "gauss")
  length_data[i] <- length(x)
  print(length(x))
  beta <- 2 * log(length(x))
  
  # Temps code R
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  pelt(x, beta, 1)
  t1 <- Sys.time()
  temps_R[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs"))
  
  # Temps code C++
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  rcpp_pelt(x, beta, 1)
  t1 <- Sys.time()
  temps_Rcpp[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs"))
}

plot(length_data, temps_R, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "red",
     xlab = "n : length of data", ylab = "Time (s)",
     main = "Time Exec PELT", ylim = c(0, max(max(temps_Rcpp),max(temps_R)) * 1.1))
lines(length_data, temps_Rcpp, type = "b", pch = 17, col = "blue")
legend("topleft",
     legend = c("R", "Rcpp"),
     col = c("red", "blue"),
     pch = c(16, 17),
     lty = c(NA, NA),
     lwd = c(NA, NA))
grid()
cat("Time factor :", temps_R[length(temps_R)] / temps_Rcpp[length(temps_Rcpp)])
```

# Smallest Valid Partitioning

```{r SIMU SVP_valid_FOCUS}
n <- 300
gap <- 10

nb_simu <- 30
cp_OP_count <- 0
cp_Focus_count <- 0
for (i in 1:nb_simu)
{
  print(i)
  data <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(0.1,0.3,0.4,0.45,0.55,0.7,0.75,0.95,1)*n,
                         parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0),
                         sdNoise = 1.5,
                         type = "gauss")
  
  gamma <- 2*log(length(data))*dust::sdDiff(data, method = "HALL")^2
  res_focus <- smallest_valid_partitioning_VR(data, gamma, test = valid_FOCUS)
  res_OP <- smallest_valid_partitioning_VR(data, gamma)
  if (length(res_OP$changepoints) > length(res_focus$changepoints))
  {
    cp_OP_count <- cp_OP_count + 1
  }
  else
  {
    cp_Focus_count <- cp_Focus_count + 1
  }
}

cat("Among the 30 simulations :\n")
cat(cp_OP_count, "times where OP has more changepoints than `valid_FOCUS`\n")
cat(cp_Focus_count, "times where `valid_FOCUS` has more changepoints than OP")
```

```{r SIMU SVP_valid_RANGE}
gap <- 1
n <- 500
data <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(0.1,0.3,0.4,0.45,0.55,0.7,0.75,0.95,1)*n,
                         parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0),
                         sdNoise = 5.5)

plot(data, type = 'b')
abline(v = c(0.1,0.3,0.4,0.45,0.55,0.7,0.75,0.95,1)*n, col = 2, lwd = 3)

pen <- 2 * log(n) * dust::sdDiff(data, method = "HALL")
#penQ <- qnorm(p = 0.95)*dust::sdDiff(data, method = "HALL")

nb_simu <- 30
cp_OP_count <- 0
cp_Range_count <- 0
for (i in 1:nb_simu)
{
  print(i)
  resOP <- rcpp_optimal_partitioning(data, beta = pen)
  resRange <- smallest_valid_partitioning_VR(data, gamma = pen, test = valid_RANGE)
  if (length(resOP$changepoints) >= length(resRange$changepoints))
  {
    cp_OP_count <- cp_OP_count + 1
  }
  else
  {
    cp_Range_count <- cp_Range_count + 1
  }
}
cat("Among the 30 simulations :\n")
cat(cp_OP_count, "times where OP has more changepoints than `valid_RANGE`\n")
cat(cp_Range_count, "times where `valid_RANGE` has more changepoints than OP")
```

# SVP_PELT = PELT ?

```{r SVP_PELT__equal__PELT}
gap <- 2
n <- 500
data <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(0.1,0.3,0.4,0.45,0.55,0.7,0.75,0.95,1)*n,
                         parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0),
                         sdNoise = 1.5)
pen <- 2 * log(n) * dust::sdDiff(data, method = "HALL")
pen <- 30

plot(data, type = 'b')
abline(v = c(0.1,0.3,0.4,0.45,0.55,0.7,0.75,0.95,1)*n, col = 2, lwd = 3)


resPELT <- pelt(data, penalty = pen)
cpts <- resPELT$changepoints
plot(data, type = "o", main = paste("PELT using R, beta =", round(pen, 2)),
     ylab = "Values", xlab = "Time", col = "blue")
abline(v = cpts, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

cpts2 <- c(0,cpts)
for (i in 1:(length(cpts2) - 1))
{
  segment_mean <- mean(data[(cpts2[i] + 1):cpts2[i + 1]])
  segments(x0 = cpts2[i] + 1, y0 = segment_mean,
           x1 = cpts2[i+1], y1 = segment_mean,
           col = "green", lwd = 2)
}


SVP_OP <- smallest_valid_partitioning_VR(data, gamma = pen)
cpts <- SVP_OP$changepoints
plot(data, type = "o", main = paste("SVP_valid_OP, gamma =", round(pen, 2)),
     ylab = "Values", xlab = "Time", col = "blue")
abline(v = cpts, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

cpts2 <- c(0,cpts)
for (i in 1:(length(cpts2) - 1))
{
  segment_mean <- mean(data[(cpts2[i] + 1):cpts2[i + 1]])
  segments(x0 = cpts2[i] + 1, y0 = segment_mean,
           x1 = cpts2[i+1], y1 = segment_mean,
           col = "green", lwd = 2)
}


plot(resPELT$nb)
plot(SVP_OP$nb)
res_focus <- smallest_valid_partitioning_VR(data, gamma = pen, test = valid_FOCUS)
plot(res_focus$nb)
resRange <- smallest_valid_partitioning_VR(data, gamma = 8, test = valid_RANGE)
plot(resRange$nb)
resRange_slack <- smallest_valid_partitioning_VR(data, gamma = 4, test = valid_RANGE_SLACK)
plot(resRange_slack$nb)
```

# Comparison of segmentations using ARI

```{r ARI_valid_FOCUS_valid_RANGE}
gap <- 2
n <- 1000
data <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(0.1,0.3,0.4,0.45,0.55,0.7,0.75,0.95,1)*n,
                         parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0),
                         sdNoise = 1.5)
pen <- 2*log(n)*dust::sdDiff(data, method = "HALL")


res_1 <- smallest_valid_partitioning_VR(data, gamma = pen, test = valid_FOCUS)
res_1$changepoints
res_2 <- smallest_valid_partitioning_VR(data, gamma = 8, test = valid_RANGE)
res_2$changepoints

cpts <- res_1$changepoints
plot(data, type = "o", ylab = "Values", xlab = "Time", col = "blue",
     main = "valid_FOCUS")
abline(v = cpts, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

cpts <- c(0,cpts)
mean_values <- integer(length(cpts) - 1)
for (i in 1:(length(cpts) - 1))
{
  segment_mean <- mean(data[(cpts[i] + 1):cpts[i + 1]])
  segments(x0 = cpts[i] + 1, y0 = segment_mean,
           x1 = cpts[i+1], y1 = segment_mean,
           col = "green", lwd = 2)
  mean_values[i] <- segment_mean
}

times <- cpts[2]
for (i in 2:length(mean_values))
{
  times[i] <- cpts[i+1] - cpts[i]
}
partition_1 <- rep(mean_values, times = times)

cpts <- res_2$changepoints
plot(data, type = "o", ylab = "Values", xlab = "Time", col = "blue",
     main = "valid_RANGE")
abline(v = cpts, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

cpts <- c(0,cpts)
mean_values <- integer(length(cpts) - 1)
for (i in 1:(length(cpts) - 1))
{
  segment_mean <- mean(data[(cpts[i] + 1):cpts[i + 1]])
  segments(x0 = cpts[i] + 1, y0 = segment_mean,
           x1 = cpts[i+1], y1 = segment_mean,
           col = "green", lwd = 2)
  mean_values[i] <- segment_mean
}

times <- cpts[2]
for (i in 2:length(mean_values))
{
  times[i] <- cpts[i+1] - cpts[i]
}
partition_2 <- rep(mean_values, times = times)

ARI(partition_1, partition_2)
```
